{
  "name": "ambient",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "An animated strip above the prompt that moves with the work, in eight styles from a request mesh to a lava lamp",
  "author": {
    "name": "Adam"
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Style",
      "description": "What the strip shows: network, critter, aurora, synthwave, warp, murmuration, lava or wave. /ambient styles describes each; a style picked with /ambient wins over this",
      "options": [
        "network",
        "critter",
        "aurora",
        "synthwave",
        "warp",
        "murmuration",
        "lava",
        "wave"
      ],
      "default": "network"
    },
    "rows": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Strip height",
      "description": "Rows the strip takes above the prompt, 1 to 6 (critter uses at least 3, synthwave at least 4)",
      "options": [
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4",
        "5",
        "6"
      ],
      "default": "3"
    },
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "How bright the strip draws: soft, bright or vivid",
      "options": [
        "soft",
        "bright",
        "vivid"
      ],
      "default": "bright"
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "Colors for every style but network. auto follows the current ccs-theme Ghostty theme",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "nightshade",
        "rose-pine",
        "kanagawa-wave",
        "kanagawa-dragon",
        "catppuccin-mocha",
        "catppuccin-latte",
        "dusk"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
